summary: Phase 3 meets the brief. Pest 4 runs alongside the unchanged class tests (tests/Pest.php scoped to Feature closures). PHPStan level 6 with Larastan passes with a 3-entry documented baseline (the Filterable `?? []` fallback, one per model) and no inline ignores. Pint uses the laravel preset and excludes Blade. Rector uses conservative sets (deadCode, codeQuality, typeDeclarations, LARAVEL_130_WITHOUT_ATTRIBUTES, PHP set from composer), skips migrations and the readonly rules, and its rewrites are behaviour-preserving in reachable paths. Composer scripts and the new quality.yml (PHP 8.5, SQLite, npm ci/build, composer quality) are in place. deploy.yml was last modified before Phase 3 started. Part B is implemented and covered by four new Pest files: success-page per-status redirect, past_due/unpaid immediate cancel with a data-confirm SweetAlert2 form, AccountDeletionService cancelling Stripe before deletion and blocking on failure with a pt-BR error and an id-only log, the recurring Free cap read from plan_limits with Pro unlimited, and the plan.limit decision documented. FEAT evidence records composer quality exit 0 and 330 tests / 1046 assertions for artisan test, artisan test --order-by=random and pest, plus route:list, view:cache/clear and npm build succeeding. No secrets were found. The remaining findings are non-blocking accuracy and edge-case items.
findings: Recurring 'retry after upgrade' overpromise (confirmed, non-blocking): docs/billing/phase-2-stripe.md says cap-skipped dates are generated if the user upgrades, but ProcessRecurringTransactions resumes after $last->date, so skipped dates are lost as soon as any later occurrence (e.g. next month) is created. Reword the doc, or track skipped dates if retrying is intended.

Account deletion blocked permanently when Stripe no longer has the subscription (likely, non-blocking): AccountDeletionService treats every gateway exception as fatal, so a stale local row (subscription/customer deleted in Stripe, missed webhook) raises resource_missing on every attempt and the user can never self-delete (LGPD). Consider mapping Stripe resource_missing to 'already canceled' and adding a test.

Missing-owner series behaviour misrecorded (confirmed, non-blocking): FEAT-002 says a series with a null user 'keeps old behaviour (no cap)', but the command `continue`s and skips such series entirely (soft-deleted owners stop generating). Correct the record or the code and add a test for a soft-deleted owner.

PHP 8.3 deploy-target rationale inaccurate (likely, non-blocking): docs/quality/phase-3-tooling.md justifies not using php85 because the deploy target 'only has to support 8.3', but composer.lock already required PHP >= 8.4 before Phase 3 (symfony 8.x). Keep the conservative Rector setting; fix the stated reason.
